title: paahi paahi jagan mohana krishna
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"paahi paahi jagan mohana krishna paramaananda sree krishnaa

devaki vasudeva nandana krishnaa divya sundara sree krishnaa

nanda yasodha nandana krishna indu vadhana sree krishnaa

kunda radhana kuti laa laka krishnaa mandas mitha sree krishnaa

chanchala lanjala noopura krishna manjula vesha sree krishnaa

kinkinee rajitha ghanam ghana krishna kreetaa lola sree krishnaa

kumkuma panka vipangkila krishna gooda mahima sree krishnaa

tharalitha kuntala manditha krishna thaandava lola sree krishnaa

dhikkruta sura ripu mandala krishna dheena paalana krishnaa

saadhu saadhu nata vesha sree krishna sathya sandha sree krishnaa

paalitha narayana theertha sree krishna parama paavana krishnaa

saadhaka phaladha krishna safala","order":1}]

title: aalokaya sree baala krishnam
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"aaloka yey sree baala krish nam sakhee

aananda sundara thaandava krishnam

navaneetha khanda dadhi chora krishnam bhaktha

bhava paasha bandhana mochana krishnam

neela megha shyaa mala sundara krishnam nitya

nirmmalaa nanda bodha lakshana krishnam

charana nikva nitha noopura krishnam sakhi

kara kali tha kanaka kan kana krishnam

kingini jaala khanam ghanha krishnam loka

shankitha thaarakaavali moukthika krishnam

sundara naa saa mauktika shobitha krishnam nanda

nandam akhanditha vibhoothi krishnam

khandopa khanta shobhi kausthuba krishnam kali

kal msaha thimira bhaashkara krishnam

vamshee naadha vinoda sundara krishnam parama

hamsa kula shamsitha chaaritra krishnam

go vatsa brinda paalana krishnam kritha

gopikaa baalaka khelana krishnam

nanda su nan daadi vanditha krishnam sree

naarayana theertha varada krishnam

shankee chakree gadhee padmee shaarngee kireeta kuntalee

sree vatsa kausthubhee divya peethaambharo viraajathey","order":1}]

title: maamaka aparaadha shatham
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"maamaka apa raadha shatham kshamya thaam twayaa

maamaka apa raadha shatham maagana yaadha vaa/yutham

shyaama varnna shamaanvitha shaashwatha ananda sandoha

athyantha kripaa saagara aadhi purushaan aadhaara

nithya jagath aa dhaara ninhu thaa sura

sruthyantha vana sanchaara shobana phaladh aa chaara

brithya dayaa dhrithaa kaara brama maa rana vidhaara

kaama shatha koti vesha khanditha ni khila dosha

daamodaro dhaara bhaasha daasa po sha

kamala kritha abhi laasha kaamanaa kalithaa sesha

saama geethaa srithaa sesha saadhu ganha santosha

aaditya chandra mandala abhyanthara aa dhaara nirmmala

bodha roopa anandhaa chala poshitha akhila

vedha puraana aadhi moola venu gaana kreedaa lola

sundara thara gokula sreedhara naatha gopaala

dhaaraa dharaa kaara dheera gho raari samhaara soora

neeraja naabha nirupama nirmmalaa nanda

paaraa vaara sree vihaara paapa thimira bhaaskara

naaraayana theertha santhaara naanaa gamaantha sanchaara

…………………………………………………………

laalayanthee yashodha saanandhasya maahishee sutham

charandham kardhama bhuvi thwarayaa jagruhey harim","order":1}]

title: dhanyoham krishnaa
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"dhanyoham krishnaa krishna dhanyoham

thava naama keerthanena dhanyoham

brahmaadhibhi: maanyoham

dhanyoham hi krishna thava paadha aravindha

smarana maatrena ki manya saadhanena

ashwamedha vara yajnai: kim

anya dharma jaala samjnai:

vishwa karthareesha vidhritha jeeva paashai:

shashwath bhakthi rasthu thava kripaa maatrena

ajaamilaadhi samuddharana divya charana

ajitha sarva loka sharana

gaja raajendra bhaya harana divya charana

vijaya gopaala sree gopikaa ramana","order":1}]

title: govinda krishna paahi
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"govinda krishna paahi yadhuvee raa – raaja

gopaala krishna paahi yadhuvee raa

raadhaa madhana kumudha poorna chand raa punya

gaadhaa nandhitha muni jana saanth raa

kamalaa vallabha divya kanja neth raa – gopa

yamalaar juna bhanjana neela gaath raa

chanchala manikuntala chaaru haa sa – chanda

chaanoora mushtikaasura dhamana haa sa

kaaleeya phana ranga naatya lo laa – baala

kelee visaa radha manogna lee laa

thaapaadhi rahitha thamaala nee laa– vijaya

gopaala gopeejana keli lo laa

navaneetha chora navaneetha chora navaneetha chora gopaal","order":1}]

title: paahi madhana gopaala mukunda
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"paalitha pari paalitha muchukunda

nanda nandana nandhitha muni jana

manda haasa vadha naa hare krishna

dhanditha ripu jana andaja vaahana

punda reeka naya naa hare krishna

arjuna chela sajjana paala

barjjitha ripu jaa laa hare krishna

kunjara poshana manjula baashana

manjeera padha yuga laa hare krishna

vaali mardhana vaanara poshana

vaaridhi bandha naa hare raama

namavali

govinda govinda gopaala govinda raam gopaala raam","order":1}]

title: nanda vara kumaara navaneeta
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"naarayana naarayana sankarabharanam /mayamalawa gowlai/ roopakam

nanda va ra kumaara navaneeta dadi choraa

manjula kun jaa bhoosha maayaa maa nusha vesha

naaraayana naaraayana naaraayana naaraayana

naaraayana naaraayana jaya gopaa la harey

manjulaa kun jaa bhoosha maayaa maa nusha vesha

karunaa apaaraa vaara varunaalaya gambheeraa

peetaambara pari dhaana sura kalyaa na nidhaana

raadhaa dhara madhu rasika rajanee kara kula tilaka

govardhana giri dharana gopee maa nasa harana

muralee gaa na vilola vyathyastha padha kamala

yamunaa thee ra vihaara dhruta kausthubha mani haara

agha paga khaga kamsaarey keshava krish na muraarey

vara bhadraa chala vaasaa paalitha sree raama daasa","order":1}]

title: naarayanam bhajey narayanam
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"naaraya nam bhajey naaraya nam lakshmi

naaraya nam bhajey naaraya nam

vrindaava nas sthitham naaraya nam deva

vrindha bahu sthutham naaraya nam

dinakara karaambaram naaraya nam divya

kanaka kankana dharam naaraya nam

pankaja vilo chanam naaraya nam bhakta

sankata vimo chanam naaraya nam

karunaa payo nidhim naaraya nam bhavya

sharanaa gatha nidhim naaraya nam

rakshitha jaga thrayam naaraya nam chakra

shikshitha sura chayam naaraya nam

ajnaana naa shakam naaraya nam bhakta

vijnaana bhaa sakam naaraya nam

sree vatsa bhoo shanam naaraya nam nanda

go vatsa po shanam naaraya nam

sringaara naa yakam naaraya nam padha

gangaa vidhaayakam naaraya nam

sree kanta saha charam naaraya nam divya

vaikunta pura charam naaraya nam

kari mukthi daa yakam naaraya nam bhadra

giri ratna naa yakam naaraya nam","order":1}]

title: amalaa shayanutha
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"amalaa shaya nutha kamalaa va llabha

yamalaar jjuna banja naa hare krishnaa

gopaala go kula paripaala maam paahi

govinda yadhu nandana hare krishna gopaala yadhu nandana

arunaa nuja vaaha karunaa rasa poorna

varunaa laya maadhava hare krishnaa

charanaa natha jana bharanaa nagha sheela

sharanaa gatha paalaka hare krishnaa

indu kulo thbava chandana char cchitha

mandaa kini janaka hare raamaa

chakraa yudha loona nakraa nana chaaru

chakraan jitha kuntala hare krishnaa

kam saadi ripu kula himsana natha jana

sam saara baya mochana hare krishnaa

gopa vadhoo jana thaapa nivaa raka

neepa manjaree bhooshana hare krishnaa

varunaa laya nutha charana akhila loka

sharanaam buru hekshanaa hare krishnaa

badram mama kuru vidraa vitha papa

badraadri raghu pungava hare raama","order":1}]

title: nandaathmajaanandha
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"nandaathma jaa nanda sandoha yadhu brundha

man dhaara govinda pari paahi maam

sara sija chara na sakala loka shara na

bhava sindhu thara na paapa vrindha hara na

thapaneeya che la thaa pimcha nee la

go paala baa la gopee jana lo la

kasthoori phaa la kalhaara maa laa

kama neeya che la kali hara lee laa

kausthubha bhoosha kalyaana vesha

nanditha ghosha navaneetha mosha

nirjjitha rosha varjitha dosha

manjula bhaasha maanitha shesha

sakala loke shaa shada padha ke sha

bharjeetha bhava paa sha bhaanu sam kaa sha

vimalaamshu haa ra vedaanta saa ra

kamsa vi haa ra kamaneeya haa ra

yamunaa vihaa ra yaadava vee raa

navaneeraad akaara naa gaari cho ra

padmaaya thaa ksha paandava pa ksha

kari vara ra ksha kalihathi da ksha

aandhrada nee pa aananda roo paa

paalitha go pa parihritha thaa pa

ripu jana bhee ma rupa jitha kaa ma

paahi sathya kaa ma bhadraadri raa ma

hey gopaalakaa hey kripaa jala nidhey

hey sindhu kanyaapathey hey kamsaanthakaa

hey gajendra karunaa paareena hey maadhavaa

hey ramaanujaa hey jagathraya guroh

hey pundaree kaakshamaam hey gopee jana naatha paalayaa

param jaanaami natwaam vinaa","order":1}]

title: naaraayana harey govinda
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"naarayana harey govindaa maam paahi

nalinaaksha keshava mukunda maam paahi

aalola tulasi vana maala maam paahi

avirala alamkritha phaala maam paahi

baalaka prahlaada pari paala maam paahi

shyaamala su varna sama chela maam paahi

kanaka parvatha sama dhairya maam paahi

kothanda bhanga prachanda veerya maam paahi

raavana sodara raajya pradha maam paahi

kaarana maanusha moksha pradha maam paahi

naarada sangeetha sukha lola maam paahi

naanaa vidha kusuma vana maala maam paahi

karunaa saagara kama neeya maam paahi

kanjaaksha bhaktha vara geya maam paahi

bhaktha jana hrudaya nivaasa maam paahi

bharathaagraja bhadraachala vaasa maam paahi","order":1}]

title: gopika ramana gokulotsava
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"gopika ramana gokulotsava govinda jaya paahimaam

paahimaam paahimaam govinda jaya paahimaam

nanda nandana indu vadana sundara jaya paahimam

kundalaalankrutha andajaasana pundareekaksha paahimaam

chanda kothanda kandithaasura pandithaasraya paahimaam

dhaanavaanthaka dheena mandhaara baanu vamsaja paahimaam

siddha sannutha vrudhdha sevitha sidhdha sankalpa paahimaam

naaradaarchitha vedasannutha paadha pankaja paahimaam

paathakaanthaka poothanaa hara pootha chaarithra paahimaam

induvamsaja kuntha rathana chandhanaa liptha paahimaam

heeraalankrutha haara booshana dheera sekara paahimaam

vaaranaarthi nivaarana akhila loka kaarana paahimaam.

dhaana shaundeera gaana lola samaana rahitha paahimaam

vatsa paala sreevatsalaanjana vatsa soodana paahimaam

badraguna su badraa poorvaja badraadreeswara paahimaam","order":1}]

title: krishna krishna govinda krishna
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"krishnaa krishnaa govinda krish naa

govinda govinda gopaala krish naa

raaja go paalaa ramaneeya ve shaa

raadhaa vallabha gopaala krish naa

kamalaa vallabha kamalaaya thaa kshaa

kamsa mardhana gopaala krish naa

khandendhu koteera khalithopa chaa raa

khanditha daithyeya gopaala krishnaa

ghaja raaja rakshaka gambeera hrudaya

gathi jitha gaja raaja gopaala krishnaa

chandhana charchitha chaaru kale bhara

chambaka naasika gopaala krishnaa

raasa kreedaa ramani vallabha

rathi pathi janaka gopaala krishnaa

bhavya gunaalaya bhava dukha hara

bhadraadri vaasaa gopaala krishnaa","order":1}]

title: kamala vallabha govindha maam
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"kamala vallabha govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

kamaneeyaanana govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

kanja vilochana govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

kaaliya mardhana govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

yashodha baala govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

yadukula tilakaa govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

nitya mahotsava govindha maam paahi kalyana krishna govinda

title: ashtapadhi 24 – kuruyadu
lyricsV1:
[{"type":"lyrics","text":"Ashtapadi -24 (anyonya anurraga soochaka alankaaram) Shurutti / Behag / Adi

Adha kaantham rathisraantham abhimandana vaanchaya

jagaadha maadhavam raadha mugdhaa swaadheena barthrukaa

1. Kuru yadhu nandhana chandana shishi ra
tharEna karEna pa yo dha rEy
mruga madha pathrakam athra manO bhava
mangala kalasha sa hO dha rEy
nijagaadha saa yadhu nandaney kreedathi hrudayaa nandaney

2. Ali kula bhan janam anjana kam rathi
naa yaka saa yaka mO cha ney

ujwala ya priya lO cha ney

manasija paasha vilaasa dharey subha
gey vini vEshaya kun Da lEy

ram su chi ram mama sam mu khEy

6. ghana ruchi rEy chi ku rEy kuru maa nadha
maanasa ja dhwaja chaa ma rEy

shikhanDi shikhanDaka Daa ma rEy

7. Sarasa ghaney ja ganey mama shambara
dhaarana vaarana kan dha rey
mani rasha naa vasa naa bhara naani
subhaashaya vaasaya sun da rey

8. Sree jaya deva ruchira vacha ney hruda
yam sada yam kuru manda ney
hari chara na smara naamrutha nirmitha
kalikalu sha jwara khan da ney
nijagaadha saa yadhunandaney kreedathi hrudayaa nandaney
nanda nandaney bhaktha chandaney nijagaadhasa

Rachaya kuchayo: pathram chithram kurushwa kapolayo:

[{"type":"lyrics","text":"Ashtapadi -11 (sakhi upadesham) Kedaragowlam/Yamunakalyaani / Adi

Poorvam yathra samam thvayaa rathipathe: (r)aasaadhithaa: ssidhdhaya:

ratisukhasaare gatamabhisaare madanamanoharavesham |
na kuru nitambini gamana vilambanam anusara tam hrudayesham (radhe) ||
dheerasameere yamunaateere vasati vane vanamaalee
gopi peenapayodhara mardana chanchala kara-yugashaalee || 1 ||

naamasametam krutasanketam vaadayate mruduveNum |
bahu manute nanu te tanu sangata pavana chalatimapi reNum (radhe)|| 2 ||

patati patatre vichalati patre shankita bhavadupayaanam |
rachayati shayanam sachakitanayanam pashyati tava panthaanam (radhe)|| 3 ||

mukharamadheeram tyaja manjeeram ripumiva kelishu lolam |
chala sakhi kunja satimirapunjam sheelaya neelanilochanam (radhe)|| 4 ||

urasi muraare roopahitahaare ghana iva taralabalaake |
taDidiva peete rativipareete raajasi sukrutavipaake (radhe)|| 5 ||

vigalita vasanam parihrutarasanam ghaTaya jaghanamapidhaanam |
kisalayashayane pankajanayane nidhimiva harshanidhaanam (radhe)|| 6 ||

harirabhimaanee rajaniridaaneemiyamapi yaati viraamam |
kuru mama vachanam satvararachanam pooraya madhuripukaamam (radhe)|| 7 ||

shree jayadeve kruta hariseve bhaNati parama ramaNeeyam |
pramudita hrudayam harimitasadayam namata sukruta kamaneeyam (radhe) || 8 ||

vikirati mahuh shvaasaana ashaaha puro muhureekshate
pravishati muhuh kunjam gunjan mahur bahu taamyati |
rachayati muhuh shayyaam paryaakulam muhureekshate
madanakadanaklaantaha kaante priyastava vartate || 3 ||

tvadvaamyena smam samagramadhunaa tigmaamshurastum gato
govindasya manorathena cha samam praaptam tamah saandrataam |
kokaanaam karuNasvanena sadrushee deerghaa madhabhyarthanaa
tanmugdhe viphalam vilambanamasou ramyo abhisarakshaNah || 4 ||

aashleshaadanu chumbanaadanu nakhollekhaadanu svaantaja prodvodhaadanu
sambhramaadanu rataarambhaadanu preetayoh |
anyaartham gatayoho bhramaanmilitayoho sambhaashaNaihi jaanatoho dampatya iha ko na ko na tamasi vreeDaavimishro rasaha || 5 ||

sabhayachakitam vinyasyanteem drusham timire pathi
pratitaru muhuh sthitvaa mandam padaani vitanvateem |
kathamapi rahaha praaptaam angaihi ananga tarangibhihi
sumukhi subhagaha pashyansa tvaamupaitu krutaarthataam || 6 ||

raadhaa mugdha mukhaaravinda madhupastrailokya moulisthalee
nepathyochita neelaratnam avanee bhaaraavataaraantakah |
svacChandam vrajasundareejana manastosha pradoshayah
kamsa dhvamsana dhoomaketuravatu tvaam devakeenandanah || 7 ||
